text.description_html:
AHI SIG3001-P22, Matte Black Mortise Lock Entry Handleset

The Matte Black Stainless Steel Mortise Entry Handleset is made from heavy gauge plated steel UL & ULC listed for custom residential, high traffic commercial, institutional, and industrial uses where durability and security are of the greatest concern. It is UL-listed for 3 hours. Choose from Dummy or Standard Entry Functions.

All Stainless Steel Trim: Extremely resistant to corrosion, knocks, scratches and abrasion making it an ideal material for door hardware. It needs little looking after and does not degrade in appearance or function with use.

Mortise Lockcase: Heavy gauge plated steel UL & ULC listed for custom residential, high traffic commercial, institutional and industrial uses where durability and security are of the greatest concern. Lock function for use with Schlage C Series cylinders. UL-listed for 3 hours. UL label stamped on front (ULC available) UL sticker on case.

Specifications of the AHI SIG3001 Stainless Steel Mortise Entry Door Handleset:

  • Material: 304 Solid Stainless Steel Trim
  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Mortise Case Faceplate: 1-1/4" Stainless steel
  • Latch Bolt: Brass anti-friction type
  • Deadbolt: Forged brass with hardened steel inserts
  • Backset: 2-3/4" (70mm)
  • Door Thickness: 2-1/4"
  • Strike plate: Stainless steel ANSI standard 4-7/8" x 1-1/4" x 1-1/8" lip to center
  • Exterior Plate Height: 17-1/4" (438 mm)
  • Exterior Plate Width: 2-3/8" (60 mm)
  • Interior Plate Height: 11" (280 mm)
  • Interior Plate Width: 2-3/8" (60 mm)
  • AHI SIG3004 Dimensions (PDF)

When Selecting a Function:

  • Dummy Set:Dummy handlesets are rigid and for looks only. They are Non-Locking and Non-Latching. They are used as a pull or to match trim.
  • Standard Entry: From the exterior, a thumb piece operates the handleset latch and a key operates the deadbolt. From the inside, a thumbturn unlocks the deadbolt and a knob/lever operates the latch.

Special Ordered Item No Returns
